page.overview:
Who is Fairness Devil?

The の|Kōsei no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of fairness.

The Fairness Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Fairness Devil's personality is currently unknown.

The Fairness Devil was first mentioned by a Public Safety Devil Hunter alongside Equality Devil as a possible explanation for the appearance of the Justice Devil, before the latter's true name was revealed.
